title: SpaceX Stock (SPCX) Falls 7.7% as AI Stocks Slide (Nov 20)
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) closed at $127.79 on Nov 20, down 7.69% and 2.41 points worse than the Nasdaq, as an AI-led sell-off hit Wall Street.
body_markdown:
## Why SpaceX Stock Fell


None of the reports we reviewed named a SpaceX-specific event behind Friday's decline, so the move tracks a market-wide sell-off. According to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/19/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) , the[Anthropic IPO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/anthropic-ipo-prices-83-raises-81-billion/) led investors to take profits on the AI-led rally rather than revive it, leaving the S&P 500 and the Dow in correction and the Nasdaq Composite negative for 2026. CNBC added that the[Nasdaq-100](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/nasdaq-100-how-the-index-works-and-who-gets-in/) entered a bear market during the session.


CNBC also reported that selling in Nvidia picked up after Reuters said the US Securities and Exchange Commission is exploring possible accounting issues at the company. ARK Investment Management's Brett Winton told CNBC that a key worry is whether the huge research and development spending of Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceX will generate sufficient returns.


SpaceX's own recent news centers on that AI buildout. As reported by[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/spacex-expects-pass-one-gigawatt-184008069.html) , SpaceX priced $32 billion of chip-backed debt at 8.259% on Nov. 19, and Apollo and Goldman Sachs said the next day that demand let them enlarge the full financing to about $44 billion. The same report quoted Elon Musk, speaking at the TomorrowX Summit on Nov. 18, as saying SpaceX is bringing on about half a gigawatt of AI compute per month. No source we read tied these items directly to Friday's drop.


## SPCX Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- SpaceX's Super Intelligence segment brought in $7.56 billion of the company's $14.6 billion third-quarter revenue, up from $2.56 billion the quarter before, per[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/cathie-wood-just-bought-22-193517184.html) .
- Starlink earned $2.37 billion of the company's $2.79 billion third-quarter operating income, and SpaceX held $89.9 billion of cash and marketable securities at Sept. 30, the same report said.
- ARK Invest's ARKK and ARKW funds added 174,991 SpaceX shares between them on Friday, TIKR reported, citing ARK's daily trade email.


### Risks


- One Super Intelligence customer supplied 34.5% of third-quarter revenue, and the Anthropic contract lets either side walk away on 90 days' notice after its first three months, per TIKR.
- Management guided fourth-quarter capital spending of $35 billion to $40 billion, up from $19.6 billion in the third quarter, TIKR reported.
- Up to 797.6 million more shares can be sold when the IPO lock-up ends on Dec. 8, according to TIKR.
- [The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/buy-tesla-spacex-stock-potential-222102160.html) , citing Bloomberg, reported that SpaceX and Tesla are in advanced merger discussions, and that an all-stock deal would dilute existing SpaceX shareholders.
